description.value: Sushi Yen is a Japanese restaurant on Sixth Street in downtown New Westminster offering a broad menu spanning sashimi, specialty rolls, noodles, donburi, curry, and bento. The wheelchair-accessible dining room provides comfortable indoor seating for cyclists seeking a sit-down meal after a ride. It is a compact, locally-run spot with a straightforward Google Sites presence and a loyal neighbourhood following.
